title: Register and enumerate a second repository
userIntent: Register an evaluator-owned secondary repository and confirm both repositories are visible through the public registry.

intendedBehavior: The public registry accepts the secondary local Git repository and lists it beside the primary repository.
behavioralInvariants: Repository identities remain distinct and both point to evaluator-owned clones.
regressionRisks: Second-repository registration is rejected, merged with primary identity, or omitted from projection.

provenance.note: Shared multi-repository behavior anchored to the exact v1.7.2 release.
